messages:
jasper_acme: Hey team — our dev account acct_9f3c got a free-trial hold when we tried to redeem the promo. Getting `trial_hold: fraud_checks` in the UI. We're blocked from onboarding, can someone take a look? Screenshot: https://uploads.acme/snap.png

fraud-bot: Automated hold applied: reason=multiple_proxy_ip, email_disposable=false, risk_score=0.82, checks=[ip_proxy, email_age, card_asset]. Escalate for manual review if false positive.

eva: Sorry about the interruption — I can escalate. Quick Qs so we can speed this up: what's the email domain used to sign up? last4 of the billing card (if you used one)? and the public IP you created the account from? Redact anything sensitive if needed.

jasper_acme: Email is jasper@acme.dev (company GSuite). Card last4: 4242. Public IP at time of signup: 45.33.21.77 (we spun up a DO dev box for an internal test, not a VPN).

eva: Thanks — sharing that with Trust & Safety. Initial signal: MaxMind flagged the IP as hosting provider / possible shared IP which elevated risk. We'll do a manual verification. @mike_tn can you pick this up?

mike_tn: On it. Can you paste the billing page screenshot and confirm whether the card is company-issued vs disposable/prepaid? Also confirm the account creation time so I can check logs.

jasper_acme: Uploaded screenshot: https://uploads.acme/bill.png. Card is company card (issued by Acme Inc). Account created at 2025-11-10T14:12:03Z.

mike_tn: Verified screenshot and billing name match our billing provider response. IP is from a cloud host but card is company-backed and email is corporate. Risk looks like a false positive due to cloud IP + short email age. Marking as low risk and applying temporary access while we finish logs.

eva: I'll perform a temporary override now to get you unblocked. Command I run in the admin console: ```admin grant_trial --acct acct_9f3c --duration 7d --by eva --note "manual_tn_verified"``` Will follow up once done.

eva: Done. I granted 7 days of trial credits and cleared the hold for account acct_9f3c. Please try redeeming the promo and creating an API key.

jasper_acme: Confirmed — promo redeemed, trial credits received, API key created and test call succeeded. Thanks for the quick turnaround :raised_hands:

eva: Great. We'll keep monitoring the account for unusual activity for the next 48h. If anything else pops up I'll reopen the review. Closing this thread unless you need more help. :white_check_mark:
